messages.content:
Build a Chinese single-file offline Young double-slit teaching simulator. Never load network resources or libraries. Requirements are frozen:
Title 杨氏双缝干涉仿真; panels 参数调控/干涉条纹图样/归一化光强. Follow wireframe with parameter column left, pattern and curve stacked right; mobile stacked. Canvas horizontal origins and widths must match.
I_N(eta)=sinc(pi*a*eta/lambda)^2*cos(pi*d*eta/lambda)^2, sinc(t)=sin(t)/t and sinc(0)=1. lambda/a/d in nm. eta=(u-u0)/(4*Dsim*Z) in CSS-pixel display coordinates. Physical D is a different geometry quantity. Dsim/Z only change display scale, never physical I or fringe order. Full-intensity peaks differ from ideal m*lambda/d. Dark-fringe-defined central and second-order widths equal; second peak is lower.
Five parameter object keys IN ORDER: wavelength,slitSeparation,slitWidth,screenDistance,zoom. Defaults 550,5000,1000,50,1. Limits [380,750],[1000,10000],[200,3000],[1,100],[1,5]. screenDistance means Dsim. All inputs/API/URL share normalization: nonfinite -> default; clamp; slitWidth=min(slitWidth,slitSeparation). Object contains only five numbers.
DOM: input[type=range] IDs equal parameter keys; output IDs key+'-output'. Markers #wavelength-markers/#slitSeparation-markers. Canvas #interferenceCanvas/#intensityCanvas, curve tabindex=0. #intensity-tooltip hidden initially, show eta and I_N percentage on hover and Home/arrows, hide on pointer leave. Same-x indicator on both charts. #reset-button/#theme-button/#palette-button/#principle-button/#principle-modal/#modal-close-button. Modal role=dialog aria-modal with inline geometry SVG, Escape close, Tab trap, focus return.
window.PhySim: version '0.9.1' candidate; defaults,limits,ready(first-frame Promise),getParams()(copy),setParams(partial)(synchronously normalize and redraw),intensityAtEta(eta,params?)(default current),getCriticalMarkers(params?),render(). Critical markers returns {wavelength:[{kind:'bright'|'dark',order,value}],slitSeparation:[...]}. Fixed eta_ref=.11; bright d*eta_ref/lambda=positive integer; dark=nonnegative integer+.5; include only solutions in respective slider limits. Default bright lambda550/d5000 and dark d2500. d6000 yields lambda660 bright1 and lambda440 dark1.5; do not clamp out-of-range solutions.
URL numeric keys plus theme=auto/light/dark,palette=color/grayscale,compact=0/1. html[data-theme] actual light/dark; html[data-palette]; body[data-compact] true/false. Five output labels include units nm or display ratio. CSP connect-src 'none'; object-src/frame-src 'none'; allow inline scripts/styles only and data images. No fetch/WebSocket/XHR, external font/library/resource.
Native CSS/DOM/Canvas/SVG only. Style readable on desktop1440x900/mobile390x844, no overflow; both canvas same CSS width/left/center. Backing sizes multiply DPR and transform to CSS; resize redraw. file://, HTTP and network-disabled must work. No model credentials, no build tools. Include inline <style id="phy-sim-style"> and <script id="phy-sim-script">; body may be replaced later. All stages keep IDs and previous behavior.
Return ONLY a COMPLETE single HTML document, beginning <!doctype html> and ending </html>. Never JSON replacements or shell commands. Include a real head with exactly one CSP meta: default-src 'none'; connect-src 'none'; frame-src 'none'; object-src 'none'; script-src 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; img-src data:; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'. Keep this complete head in every stage and every repair.
Keep version 0.9.1 from Round1. The curve uses the full canvas CSS width with origin at width/2: each CSS x maps eta=(x-width/2)/(4*Dsim*Z); vertical plotting margins are allowed, horizontal plotting margins are NOT allowed. Draw dense curve using moveTo/lineTo/stroke, not an image. Grayscale pattern is a continuous monotonic gamma brightness profile (gamma .35..1.55). Draw in physical backing pixels or transform consistently for DPR. Both canvases must show a clear same-x vertical indicator when hovering the intensity canvas, and redraw on leave. Tooltip must include eta with >=4 decimals and I_N percentage with >=1 decimal. Home and arrows must change its values. Palettes must actually change the pattern colors, themes actual backgrounds.
Use marker CSS classes bright/dark (or data-kind), all markers in their container with count matching API, visually filled bright/hollow dark, percentage left=(value-min)/(max-min)*100. Dialog #principle-modal is an outer full-screen backdrop with >=12px padding; inner role=dialog contains #modal-close-button. Focus an inner control on opening, trap Tab AND Shift+Tab, return focus, Escape, close button and backdrop click close. Update rendering promptly after parameters change. No remote assets or runtime calls. Preserve all previous stage features. Do not include API credentials or any other program's code.
This is a current-model replication, not recovery of historical weights. Round0 is only visual semantic skeleton; no simulator JavaScript required. Later rounds implement only this trial's own code. Do not omit the head or closing html. Tests verify formula independently and inspect actual Canvas pixels, 18 Chromium combinations, focus and offline behavior.

message.reasoning_content:
The user is asking for a complete single HTML document. The draft is already mostly complete. Need to review against the requirements and fix issues.

Main requirements to verify:
- normalize: partial merge — bug: current `normalize` uses only partial or defaults, not the current params. setParams(partial) should merge with current params? Spec says "setParams(partial)(synchronously normalize and redraw)". Shared normalization: nonfinite -> default; clamp; slitWidth=min(slitWidth,slitSeparation). Hmm — "nonfinite -> default" suggests nonfinite values become defaults, not current values. But in slider input handlers, when the user moves wavelength, obj only contains wavelength — normalize(obj) would reset other params to defaults! That's a bug. In input handler: `params = normalize(obj)` — this resets everything else to defaults. Need to merge with current params. But the spec says nonfinite -> default. In the case of merging with current params, nonfinite should probably become default. Let's do this: normalize takes a partial, merges with current params (or defaults if no current), nonfinite -> default, clamp, a<=d.

Actually, for the setParams API, merging with current params is more reasonable. Let's implement normalize(partial, base), where base defaults to current params or DEFAULTS.

- URL restoration: applyURL reads the params. Also theme=auto — spec says theme=auto/light/dark. auto → probably matchMedia prefers-color-scheme; but simpler: auto → light. Handling: auto → use matchMedia if available, otherwise light.

- compact=0/1 → body data-compact true/false. Done.

- data-palette on html, data-compact on body. Done.

- Tooltip eta to 4+ decimal places: uses toFixed(5), fine. I_N to 1+ decimal place: toFixed(1), fine.

- Grayscale gamma .35..1.55: uses 0.8, fine.

- Markers: verify default bright lambda550/d5000 and dark d2500. With ETA_REF=0.11, lambda=550: bright d = lam*m/0.11 = 550/0.11 = 5000 (m=1). ✓. Dark: d = lam*(m+0.5)/0.11 = 550*0.5/0.11 = 2500 (m=0). ✓. d=6000: bright lambda = d*0.11/m = 660 (m=1) ✓; dark lambda = 6000*0.11/1.5 = 440 ✓. Good.

- "Don't clamp out-of-range solutions" — only include solutions within slider limits. Done.

- Marker count matches API. Done.

- Same-x indicator on both charts when hovering intensity canvas. Done.

- Modal focus trap done.

- CSP meta exact match. Check: draft has exactly the requested CSP. ✓

- Pattern rendering: drawing 1px fillRect per CSS pixel — but ctx is transformed by dpr, so fillRect(x,0,1,cssH) works in CSS units. Fine. But performance: per-pixel fillRect is fine.

- Curve: full CSS width, origin at width/2, no horizontal margin. Done.

- Canvas backing size multiplied by DPR and transformed. Done.

- screenDistance output: spec says "the five output labels include units nm or display ratio". screenDistance output is "50" — maybe should be unitless or something. Probably fine; zoom is "×1.0" display ratio. screenDistance is... maybe leave as-is. Actually "units nm or display ratio" — screenDistance is a display scale quantity; maybe label as "×50"? Ambiguous. Leave as numeric.

- intensityAtEta default is current params. Done.

- ready: first-frame Promise. Done.

- Restore URL view state — applyURL handles params/theme/palette/compact. Done.

Main fixes needed:
1. normalize should merge with current params for partial updates (slider input, setParams). But for URL initial load, base is defaults. Implement normalize(partial, base).
2. theme=auto handling.
3. Also when clamping slitWidth to slitSeparation: "slitWidth=min(slitWidth,slitSeparation)" — done.

Also verify: input handler for slitSeparation change when slitWidth > new d — normalize handles it.

Also the slitWidth slider max is 3000 but could be clamped to d; the input value sync displays the clamped value. Fine.

One more: `setParams` should merge partial with current params. Yes.

Also hoverX indicator on pattern canvas — done.

Escape/Tab trap done. Backdrop click closes. Focus restore.

Also verify: "tooltip hidden in initial state" — display:none in CSS. ✓ aria-hidden true.

Also pointermove on interference canvas? Spec says indicator on both charts when hovering intensity canvas. Fine.

Also `normalize` for URL: nonfinite -> default. If base is current params and partial value is nonfinite -> default (per spec). OK.

Let me write the fixed document. Keep everything else.

Also `applyURL` should merge URL params with defaults via normalize(p, DEFAULTS).

Edge case: normalize signature normalize(partial, base). If base omitted, use params if initialized, else DEFAULTS.
